text.tspan: local reads, local tokens and leases
AWS or DX down: on-prem keeps serving reads and issuing local tokens and leases; changes to shared config wait.
Region 1 down: promote the DR secondary. Vault is stateful, so clients use a DNS name and load balancer, never anycast.
